description_en: Queries the information about devices that are registered at a time
description_zh: 调用该接口查询批量注册的设备信息
name: QueryPageByApplyId

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no<props="intl"><ph> Overview page or</ph></props> ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records on each page. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量。数量限制：每页最多可显示50条。默认值是10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The application ID (ApplyId) of the batch. You can obtain the application ID from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69514.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69473.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的申请批次ID。申请批次ID可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69514.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69473.html接口返回结果中查看
parameters.name: apply_id

parameters.help_zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。默认值是1
parameters.name: current_page

ApplyDeviceInfo.description_en: The list of registered devices (ApplyDeviceInfo) returned if the call is successful
ApplyDeviceInfo.description_zh: 调用成功时，生成的已注册的设备列表（ApplyDeviceInfo）

DeviceId.description_en:
The device ID (legacy parameter).

This parameter is a legacy parameter that has no actual effect and cannot be used to identify a device. Currently, the valid device identifiers are IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName
DeviceId.description_zh:
设备ID（旧版参数）。

该参数是旧版本遗留参数，已无实际作用，不能用来标识设备。目前有效的设备标识符为IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合

IotId.description_en: The device ID, which is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device
IotId.description_zh: 设备ID，物联网平台为该设备颁发的唯一标识符

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

PageSize.description_en: The number of devices displayed per page

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful.
true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败

Total.description_en: The total number of devices in the batch
